purpose: Three new selectable Megumin concepts redrawn from official visual references; not selected or connected to the animation rig.

variants.name: A-anime-model
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: selectable full-body Megumin character illustration for a KonoSuba fan-made turn-based game mod.
Redraw the character from the provided OFFICIAL reference images into a NEW single-character full-body illustration. These images are visual references for identity, canonical costume and drawing language, not a composition to copy or a collage to reproduce. Do not use any previously generated Megumin in this conversation as the identity reference.
Accurately retain Megumin's recognizable short dark chestnut bob, slightly uneven fringe, two longer face-framing locks, deep crimson eyes, compact softly angular face, petite slender narrow-shouldered build and short torso. Ordinary anime proportions around 5.5 to 6 heads tall excluding the hat; avoid long fashion-model legs, tiny head, exaggerated hips or curves, and chibi proportions.
Canonical adventurer outfit: floppy dark brown wizard hat with wide brim, gold edge and zigzag red/gold band, two red circular badges with gold crosses, yellow/orange dangling tuft; red long-sleeved tunic/dress, gold neckline and cuffs, black chest lacing, dark brown belt with rectangular silver buckle, gold triangular hem pattern; dark brown cape with gold trim and muted warm lining; dark fingerless gloves; choker with small silver buckle; white bandage wrapping on her anatomical RIGHT leg and charcoal thigh-high stocking on her anatomical LEFT leg; orange-brown boots with turned golden cuffs. No eye patch for this comparison. Slender forked wooden staff with ONE red orb and wrapped shaft, held in anatomical RIGHT hand. Use the Bakuen reference for staff construction, deliberately use the familiar red orb for this mod concept rather than its blue orb.
Flat to two-step anime cel shading with clean controlled contour lines. No photorealism, no 3D rendering, no gritty texture, no glossy gacha airbrush, no luminous outline. No text, labels, signatures, watermark, magic particles or scenery.
Full figure, entire hat, staff head and staff tip, cape and both boots inside canvas with clear margins. Eye-level camera, no strong foreshortening. True transparent alpha background, no checkerboard baked in, no cast shadow or ground plane. One character only.
VARIANT A — restrained classic television-anime model-sheet interpretation. Prioritize image 1 and image 3 for the face, proportions and simpler flat color separation. A compact cheek/jaw shape, slightly half-lidded knowing red eyes, small proud closed smile: unmistakably Megumin, not a generic sweet anime heroine. Relaxed naturally balanced standing pose turned about 20 degrees toward screen-right, gaze screen-right. Feet planted comfortably close, knees nearly straight. Staff held upright beside the body without crossing the face or torso. Free left hand relaxed slightly away from hip so the outline is clear. Cape hangs naturally with only a little flare. Warm muted crimson cloth and brown-violet shadows. The mood is calm, cheeky confidence. Keep expressive face legible when reduced to game size.

a_correction:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target: variant A of Megumin. Image 2 is an official character reference ONLY for correct hat construction.
Correct the hat in image 1: it currently has two bent tips with two yellow tassels. Redraw the upper hat crown so there is exactly ONE bent pointed tip, drooping toward screen-right with ONE yellow-orange tassel at its end, as in image 2. Remove the entire erroneous left-facing tip and its tassel; replace that side of the crown with a clean continuous simple wizard-hat silhouette. Keep the two round red/gold cross badges, zigzag band and brim.
Preserve Megumin's face, expression, hair, anatomy, outfit, colors, pose, staff, right-leg bandages, left stocking, both hands and boots. Do not redraw the figure into a new pose.
Give the complete staff top and both boot soles a little clear canvas margin so nothing touches the frame. Keep a genuinely transparent background with clean alpha, no glow, no scenery, no text and no duplicate accessories. One full-body character only.
